Cause we need the stability of ES Module support."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Global install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Local install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Use in CLI"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> PicGo uses `SM.MS(S.EE)` as the default upload image host."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Show help:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"#### Upload a picture from path"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"#### Upload with a saved configuration"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Use `--configName` to choose a saved configuration for one upload. Add `--uploader` when the same na"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"me exists in multiple uploader types. You can also use `--configId`; a unique ID match takes precede"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"nce over the name, and an unresolved ID falls back to the name when provided."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"These options use the same lookup rules as HTTP and SDK uploads and do not change saved defaults. Wi"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"thout these options, `picgo upload` retains its existing default behavior. Existing local input file"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"s are retained after upload; only temporary multipart files and clipboard images created by PicGo ar"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"e cleaned up. Clipboard filenames keep the existing `YYYYMMDDHHmmssSSS.png` format."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"#### Upload a picture from clipboard"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"> picture from clipboard will be converted to `png`"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Thanks to vs-picgo && Spades-S for providing the method to upload picture from clipboard."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"#### Run as a server"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"##### Select a configuration for one upload"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Add `uploader`, `configName`, or `configId` to `POST /upload` to choose an existing saved configurat"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"ion for that request. Configuration names are recommended for readability. Use URL encoding for name"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"s containing spaces, Chinese characters, or other special characters:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The same query parameters work with an empty body for clipboard uploads, JSON without `list` or with"},{"id":"p37s2","text":" an empty `list`, and multipart uploads using the `files` field. If server authentication is enabled"},{"id":"p37s3","text":", include your existing `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` header."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"| Upload options | Behavior |"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| No upload options | Existing default upload behavior. |
| `uploader=github` | Use GitHub's current"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"ly selected configuration (`defaultId`, falling back to its first configuration). |
| `uploader=gith"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"ub&configName=Work` | Find `Work` within GitHub, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. |
| `conf"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"igName=Work` | Search registered uploader types; exactly one configuration must match. |
| `configId"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"=<id>` | Search by exact ID, optionally restricted by `uploader`. IDs remain stable when configurati"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"ons are renamed. |
| Both `configId` and `configName` | Use a unique ID match first; if it cannot be"},{"id":"p39s7","text":" uniquely resolved, try the name. |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Unknown uploaders, missing or ambiguous configurations, and blank or repeated upload parameters retu"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"rn HTTP `400` with `{ success: false, result: [], items: [], code, message }`. Messages explain the "},{"id":"p40s3","text":"lookup failure or ambiguity; specify `uploader` to disambiguate names shared across types. Invalid u"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"pload options never fall back to the global default uploader. Existing authentication failures remai"},{"id":"p40s5","text":" never fall back to the global default uploader. Existing authentication failures remain HTTP `401`."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"#### Login to PicGo Cloud"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"#### Logout from PicGo Cloud"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"#### Check PicGo Cloud login status"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"Use `picgo cloud auth status` to inspect the current PicGo Cloud login state without triggering an i"},{"id":"p47s2","text":"nteractive login. | `logged_out`  | N"},{"id":"p51s2","text":"o local token                                   | `1`       |
| `invalid`     | Token exists but is "},{"id":"p51s3","text":"rejected by the server (401) | `2`       |
| `error`       | Probe failed (network / server error)  "},{"id":"p51s4","text":"          | `3`       |"},{"id":"p52s1","text":"The `--format json` output is a single line, e.g.:"},{"id":"p53s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p54s1","text":"#### Inspect current module config"},{"id":"p55s1","text":"Use `picgo get` to read the currently selected picgo modules.
